snippet.title: Super Nintendo - Bishin Densetsu Zoku - The Legend of Bishin (1993)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Bishin Densetsu Zoku: The Legend of Bishin Zoku is an Action game, published by Magifact, which was released in Japan in 1993.
